title: Playing drums now; no drum lessons
summary: Foster now plays drums, has been off sax for two years, and says he never had drum lessons.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how

blocks.x: Speaking of other instruments, did you ever play anything beside the drums and the... And the appetizers.
No, I mean now, now, what do you play now?

I'm playing drums now, right now. In fact, uh, I've been off the sax now with Ciro, since we left the club at Tibidot. Yeah. And I've had two years, I've been off the sax. And New York, I was a failure job in Sweden, I've got to play rock and I've been doing a job, and I've played sax. Uh-huh.
Yes. You never had any lessons at all then on drums? No. Any other later on? You never took any?
